en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned market square lined with 2–3 story historic townhouses. Shop signs and advertisements in German are visible on the façades, including a hotel, bank, biscuit factory, butcher, and other businesses. Several people stand near the entrance of a building marked as a hotel. The printed caption at the top reads "Lommatzsch i. Sa. Markt." indicating the marketplace of Lommatzsch.
